label: Market Close
headline: S&P -1.0%, Dow -1.6%, VIX 25.46, Nvidia +4.5% after hours on beat and raised outlook
stance: Stocks fell a second day, with the Dow and software leading losses. Nvidia beat after the close and stock futures rose.

scorecard.actual: Beat on revenue, earnings and guidance (4:27pm). Shares +4.5% after hours at 6:42pm.
S&P closed -1.0%, Dow -1.6%. Selling held into the close.

scorecard.call: Semiconductor index -1.3% at 11:34, in line with the Nasdaq.
scorecard.actual: Wrong way by the close: chip index +0.3%, Nasdaq -0.7%.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Williams (2:34pm): economy getting stronger, inflation not moving in the right direction.
API: US crude stocks +5.3M barrels in the week to Nov 13, vs a 0.5M draw expected (4:58pm).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: 25 of 30 Dow stocks closed lower (4:17pm). Software led the selling.
VIX up 4 sessions in a row through today's close.
Stock futures higher after the close (6:32pm).

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Latest IG and HY spreads are Monday's. Today's equity drop is not in them yet.
The Fed flagged leveraged ETFs as a financial stability risk (12:32pm).

items.head: Nvidia beats, sees about 75% revenue growth next year
items.body: Revenue topped forecasts by $7bn (4:27pm). Board does not plan to bring back Huang (5:16pm). SEC probing its disclosures (4:17pm).

items.head: Applied Optoelectronics -8% after hours
items.body: Filed a common stock offering (5:08pm). Shares -8.1% at 6:42pm.

items.head: Dolby -5% after hours on fiscal Q4 results
items.body: Results out at 4:15pm. Shares -5.0% at 6:28pm, after -3.8% in the session.

items.head: ZTO Q3: adjusted net income RMB2.6bn
items.body: 10.2bn parcels, market share 20.1% (5:00pm). Shares -3.3% after hours at 5:55pm.

watch.head: Palo Alto Networks reports Wednesday
watch.body: Shares fell more than 4% today ahead of the report (12:01pm).
